Deconstruction.name: Deconstruction
Deconstruction.NAME: Deconstruction
Deconstruction.LR: Target an enemy building to deconstruct it. The target player will get their resources back but lose the building.

Shockwave.name: Shockwave
Shockwave.NAME: Shockwave
Shockwave.LR: Target a location on the map to send enemy units flying, stunning them for a few seconds.

GaiaForest.name: GaiaForest
GaiaForest.NAME: Gaia Forest
GaiaForest.LR: Select a location to grow a Gaia Forest. Villagers gather wood faster from Gaia Trees.

Carnivora.name: Carnivora
Carnivora.NAME: Carnivora
Carnivora.LR: Spawns a giant plant that pulls humans and ships in and devours them.

Valor.name: Valor
Valor.NAME: Valor
Valor.LR: Target one of your human units to convert it into a hero and heal it fully.

SpiderLair.name: SpiderLair
SpiderLair.NAME: Spider Lair
SpiderLair.LR: Target an area to place spider eggs which will hatch and burrow. The spiders will devour enemy human soldiers that cross through the area, but eggs can be destroyed before they hatch.

Traitor.name: Traitor
Traitor.NAME: Traitor
Traitor.LR: Target an enemy unit to convert it to your side.

Chaos.name: Chaos
Chaos.NAME: Chaos
Chaos.LR: Target a group of enemy units to make it temporarily hostile to all.

HesperidesTree.name: HesperidesTree
HesperidesTree.NAME: Hesperides Tree
HesperidesTree.LR: Select a location to create a tree that summons some Dryad myth units and can train more.

Vortex.name: Vortex
Vortex.NAME: Vortex
Vortex.LR: Target a location to transport all of your military units there.

TartarianGate.name: TartarianGate
TartarianGate.NAME: Tartarian Gate
TartarianGate.LR: Hekate opens a gate to the Underworld that unleashes creatures hostile to all. The gate will destroy any buildings in the vicinity when it is placed.

Implode.name: Implode
Implode.NAME: Implode
Implode.LR: Target a location to do massive damage to nearby units and buildings. This is more powerful when cast near a large number of enemy units.

BloodPact.name: BloodPact
BloodPact.NAME: Blood Pact
BloodPact.LR: Target any unit to grant it immense power for a short duration. When the effect ends, the unit dies, granting you Favor.

Tailwind.name: Tailwind
Tailwind.NAME: Tailwind
Tailwind.LR: Target a group of friendly units to boost their movement speed for a short duration.

ObsidianMirror.name: ObsidianMirror
ObsidianMirror.NAME: Obsidian Mirror
ObsidianMirror.LR: Target any player to secretly copy their Archaic Age God Power.

Lullaby.name: Lullaby
Lullaby.NAME: Lullaby
Lullaby.LR: Target a group of enemies to put them to sleep. Any damage dealt to sleeping units will wake them up immediately.

Infestation.name: Infestation
Infestation.NAME: Infestation
Infestation.LR: Target a location to summon an Infested Nest that periodically spawns Scorpions that obey your commands.

AgaveBloom.name: AgaveBloom
AgaveBloom.NAME: Agave Bloom
AgaveBloom.LR: Target a location to spawn a sacred Agave. Gather it for Food or let its sacred energy heal your nearby units.

EarthMonster.name: EarthMonster
EarthMonster.NAME: Earth Monster
EarthMonster.LR: Target a location to summon Tlaltecuhtli, the Earth Monster. It erupts from the ground repeatedly to swallow groups of units, trapping them underground before regurgitating survivors.

Starfall.name: Starfall
Starfall.NAME: Starfall
Starfall.LR: Target a location to bombard enemies with falling stars. Tzitzimitl star demons occasionally emerge from the craters to fight for you.

Purge.name: Purge
Purge.NAME: Purge
Purge.LR: Target an enemy military unit to mark it for sacrifice. The unit is suspended in the air, and after a short delay, all nearby enemies of the same type are destroyed, up to a total of 1400 resource value.

CorruptedGround.name: CorruptedGround
CorruptedGround.NAME: Corrupted Ground
CorruptedGround.LR: Target an area to corrupt the earth. Defeated enemies here will be reborn as vile abominations that fight for you.

Volcano.name: Volcano
Volcano.NAME: Volcano
Volcano.LR: Target a location to raise a mighty Volcano. It obliterates buildings as it rises, and bombards the surrounding area with molten rock.

ThePeachBlossomSpring.name: ThePeachBlossomSpring
ThePeachBlossomSpring.NAME: The Peach Blossom Spring
ThePeachBlossomSpring.LR: Target a location to create the Peach Blossom Spring, whose resource stockpile grows over time. The Peach Blossom Spring's resources are gathered very quickly, but its stockpile stops growing once a villager starts gathering from it.

Creation.name: Creation
Creation.NAME: Creation
Creation.LR: Target a location to create a number of Clay Peasants that last for a couple of minutes. Spawns more Peasants in later ages.

ProsperousSeeds.name: ProsperousSeeds
ProsperousSeeds.NAME: Prosperous Seeds
ProsperousSeeds.LR: Target 2 Farms to sow the seeds of prosperity. They will produce food faster, heal nearby villagers, and make friendly units on them invisible.

LightningWeapons.name: LightningWeapons
LightningWeapons.NAME: Lightning Weapons
LightningWeapons.LR: Target a location to conduct lightning into the weapons of all of your human soldiers, heroes and ships, granting their attacks a chance to stun enemies.

EarthWall.name: EarthWall
EarthWall.NAME: Earth Wall
EarthWall.LR: Raises earthen walls to surround the targeted area.

Vanish.name: Vanish
Vanish.NAME: Vanish
Vanish.LR: Target a group of friendly units to make them invisible for a short time. Attacking will reveal their position.

ForestProtection.name: ForestProtection
ForestProtection.NAME: Forest Protection
ForestProtection.LR: Target a friendly building to protect the surrounding area with Goumang's wood power, which roots enemies and heals allied units.

DroughtLand.name: DroughtLand
DroughtLand.NAME: Drought
DroughtLand.LR: Target an area to spread drought, which makes enemy buildings far easier to destroy, units easier to kill, and prevents all construction and repairs.

VenomBeast.name: VenomBeast
VenomBeast.NAME: Fei Beasts
VenomBeast.LR: Target a location to spawn poisonous Fei Beasts that spread infection to enemies.

GreatFlood.name: GreatFlood
GreatFlood.NAME: Great Flood
GreatFlood.LR: Target a path of destruction for a cataclysmic flood that sweeps away units and annihilates buildings.

BlazingPrairie.name: BlazingPrairie
BlazingPrairie.NAME: Blazing Prairie
BlazingPrairie.LR: Target a location to open the heavens and set the world on fire. Everything will burn.

YinglongsWrath.name: YinglongsWrath
YinglongsWrath.NAME: Yinglong's Wrath
YinglongsWrath.LR: Target a location to summon Yinglong, the legendary rain and lightning dragon of China.

Pandatopia.name: Pandatopia
Pandatopia.NAME: Pandatopia
Pandatopia.LR: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all units into Pandas.

Rain.name: Rain
Rain.NAME: Rain
Rain.LR: Target anywhere to make all of your Villagers gather Food from Farms faster, and fishing ships gather Food from fish faster.

Prosperity.name: Prosperity
Prosperity.NAME: Prosperity
Prosperity.LR: Target anywhere to make all of your Villagers and Trade Caravans gather Gold faster.

Vision.name: Vision
Vision.NAME: Vision
Vision.LR: Target a region of the map to be temporarily revealed.

Eclipse.name: Eclipse
Eclipse.NAME: Eclipse
Eclipse.LR: Target anywhere on the map to turn day to night, improving the abilities of your myth units and increasing the rate at which your Monuments generate Favor.

ShiftingSands.name: ShiftingSands
ShiftingSands.NAME: Shifting Sands
ShiftingSands.LR: Target your own or allied units, and then target the location where you wish to teleport them.

PlagueOfSerpents.name: PlagueOfSerpents
PlagueOfSerpents.NAME: Plague of Serpents
PlagueOfSerpents.LR: Target a location on the map where dangerous Serpents will rise from the ground or sea and protect that area from your enemies.

LocustSwarm.name: LocustSwarm
LocustSwarm.NAME: Locust Swarm
LocustSwarm.LR: Target a path of destruction. Summons a plague of locusts that attacks enemy units and buildings, devouring Farms, livestock, and Berry Bushes.

Ancestors.name: Ancestors
Ancestors.NAME: Ancestors
Ancestors.LR: Target a location to awaken ancestral soldiers or ships to fight again for a short time.

Citadel.name: Citadel
Citadel.NAME: Citadel
Citadel.LR: Select a Town Center belonging to you or an ally to transform it into a mighty, defensive Citadel, which trains units and researches technologies faster.

SonOfOsiris.name: SonOfOsiris
SonOfOsiris.NAME: Son of Osiris
SonOfOsiris.LR: Target your Pharaoh to transform him into a super-empowering, lightning-wielding demigod.

Meteor.name: Meteor
Meteor.NAME: Meteor
Meteor.LR: Target an enemy area to bombard with burning rocks from the heavens. Strong against buildings, moderately effective against units.

Tornado.name: Tornado
Tornado.NAME: Tornado
Tornado.LR: Target near an enemy to send a cyclone that will suck their buildings and units up into the sky – but stay out of its way.

Bolt.name: Bolt
Bolt.NAME: Bolt
Bolt.LR: A bolt of lightning from the sky strikes down any single military unit.

Sentinel.name: Sentinel
Sentinel.NAME: Sentinel
Sentinel.LR: Target your or an ally’s Town Center, Village Center, or Fortress to protect it with stone guardians.

Lure.name: Lure
Lure.NAME: Lure
Lure.LR: Target a location to erect a special stone which draws animals to it and spawns chickens. The Lure summons more food in later ages, and Villagers can drop off food at the Lure.

Restoration.name: Restoration
Restoration.NAME: Restoration
Restoration.LR: Target a location to heal units and repair buildings, siege weapons, and ships belonging to you or your allies.

CeaseFire.name: CeaseFire
CeaseFire.NAME: Ceasefire
CeaseFire.LR: Target anywhere on the map to prevent every player from fighting and slow the construction of ranged fortifications for a short period of time.

Pestilence.name: Pestilence
Pestilence.NAME: Pestilence
Pestilence.LR: Target an enemy town to infect it with plague. The Pestilence prevents buildings from firing projectiles and slows unit production.

UnderworldInvasion.name: UnderworldInvasion
UnderworldInvasion.NAME: Underworld Invasion
UnderworldInvasion.LR: Sacrifice all your Town and Village Centers to resurrect fallen military and Myth units. Settlements cannot be repopulated for some time.

Bronze.name: Bronze
Bronze.NAME: Bronze
Bronze.LR: Target a location to encase your soldiers, myth units, and ships with bronze, reducing their vulnerability in combat.

Curse.name: Curse
Curse.NAME: Curse
Curse.LR: Target near enemy soldiers to turn several of their units into Pigs.

UnderworldPassage.name: UnderworldPassage
UnderworldPassage.NAME: Underworld Passage
UnderworldPassage.LR: Select two locations on the map to create entrances to the Underworld through which units can move.

LightningStorm.name: LightningStorm
LightningStorm.NAME: Lightning Storm
LightningStorm.LR: Target a location to call down an electric storm from Olympus whose power increases over time. Strong against groups of enemy units.

Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Earthquake.NAME: Earthquake
Earthquake.LR: Target a location to shatter nearby enemy buildings. The epicenter of the earthquake inflicts the most damage.

Wither.name: Wither
Wither.NAME: Wither
Wither.LR: Target a location to wither berries, farms, and trees, rendering the terrain sterile for a short period of time.

ArcadianMeadow.name: ArcadianMeadow
ArcadianMeadow.NAME: Arcadian Meadow
ArcadianMeadow.LR: Target an area to temporarily turn it into a peaceful meadow. Units and buildings inside the meadow cannot attack.

CommunalHearth.name: CommunalHearth
CommunalHearth.NAME: Communal Hearth
CommunalHearth.LR: Summon a hearth that increases Villager gather rate and converts enemy units.

SolarShield.name: SolarShield
SolarShield.NAME: Solar Shield // God Power name.
SolarShield.LR: Target a unit to make it temporarily nearly invulnerable. // God power description.

Kusanagi.name: Kusanagi
Kusanagi.NAME: Kusanagi // God Power name.
Kusanagi.LR: Target a location for Susanoo to cast down his sword, Kusanagi. The sword damages nearby enemies and summons a riptide that blasts them skyward. // God power description.

NewMoon.name: NewMoon
NewMoon.NAME: New Moon // God Power name.
NewMoon.LR: Target a building to obtain all currently available technologies there for free and cause military units to train faster for a short duration. // God power description.

ShrineOfTheHunt.name: ShrineOfTheHunt
ShrineOfTheHunt.NAME: Shrine of the Hunt // God Power name.
ShrineOfTheHunt.LR: Target a Shrine to transform it into a Shrine of the Hunt, periodically spawning huntable deer as well as friendly wolves that defend the area. // God power description.

Goshinboku.name: Goshinboku
Goshinboku.NAME: Goshinboku // God Power name.
Goshinboku.LR: Target a location to summon a Goshinboku tree. The tree's blessing resurrects the owner's myth units as they fall in combat. // God power description.

Swampland.name: Swampland
Swampland.NAME: Swampland // God Power name.
Swampland.LR: Target a location to create a temporary swamp infested with Kappa that will leap out of the water and drown enemy human soldiers. // God power description.

Shogun.name: Shogun
Shogun.NAME: Shogun // God Power name.
Shogun.LR: Target a Daimyo to transform him into an immensely powerful Shogun, who summons Samurai while he fights. // God power description.

SmitingGust.name: SmitingGust
SmitingGust.NAME: Smiting Gust // God Power name.
SmitingGust.LR: Target a direction in which to unleash an immense gust of wind, blasting military units across the map. // God power description.

ThunderBurst.name: ThunderBurst
ThunderBurst.NAME: Thunder Burst // God Power name.
ThunderBurst.LR: Target a location to unleash earth-shaking shockwaves. Raijin strikes his den-den daiko drums, causing expanding rings of lightning to damage and stun enemies. // God power description.

SacredGate.name: SacredGate
SacredGate.NAME: Sacred Gate // God Power name.
SacredGate.LR: Target a location to erect a great Torii Gate which makes your God Powers cheaper and immediately enables you to invoke them once again for free. // God power description.

DragonTyphoon.name: DragonTyphoon
DragonTyphoon.NAME: Dragon Typhoon // God Power name.
DragonTyphoon.LR: Target a path of destruction. Watatsumi will descend in dragon form and erupt into a swirling typhoon, tearing through everything in his path. // God power description.

DivineSlash.name: DivineSlash
DivineSlash.NAME: Divine Slash // God Power name.
DivineSlash.LR: Target a path of destruction. Takemikazuchi will cleave the earth with a colossal katana slash, inflicting massive damage to units and stunning any survivors. // God power description.

HachimansBlessing.name: HachimansBlessing
HachimansBlessing.NAME: Hachiman's Blessing // Name of a god power.
HachimansBlessing.LR: Target Harumoto or a Daimyo to grant Hachiman's blessing, making them much stronger. // God power description.

DwarvenMine.name: DwarvenMine
DwarvenMine.NAME: Dwarven Mine
DwarvenMine.LR: Select a location to create a new Gold Mine that has more Gold and is gathered faster if used in later ages.

Spy.name: Spy
Spy.NAME: Spy
Spy.LR: Target an enemy unit to secretly see what it sees.

GreatHunt.name: GreatHunt
GreatHunt.NAME: Great Hunt
GreatHunt.LR: Target a group of wild animals to greatly multiply their numbers. If there are none, Odin will summon a small amount. Gets more powerful each age.

Gullinbursti.name: Gullinbursti
Gullinbursti.NAME: Gullinbursti
Gullinbursti.LR: Target one of your Town Centers (or your allies') to summon and command Freyr's golden boar Gullinbursti to defend the area. Gullinbursti becomes stronger each age.

ForestFire.name: ForestFire
ForestFire.NAME: Forest Fire
ForestFire.LR: Target a forest to burn it to smoldering embers, damaging nearby units and buildings.

HealingSpring.name: HealingSpring
HealingSpring.NAME: Healing Spring
HealingSpring.LR: Target a location on the map to create a spring that will heal all nearby friendly units. The spring cannot be destroyed, but can be taken over by enemy forces.

Undermine.name: Undermine
Undermine.NAME: Undermine
Undermine.LR: Target a path of destruction along which to damage enemy buildings. Walls and towers instantly collapse, and other buildings take considerable damage.

AsgardianBastion.name: AsgardianBastion
AsgardianBastion.NAME: Asgardian Bastion
AsgardianBastion.LR: Target a location to summon a foundation that will materialize into a spectral Hill Fort when fully constructed. Builds faster in later ages.

Frost.name: Frost
Frost.NAME: Frost
Frost.LR: Target near enemy units to freeze them solid for a short period of time. Frozen units cannot move, but are very hard to kill.

FlamingWeapons.name: FlamingWeapons
FlamingWeapons.NAME: Flaming Weapons
FlamingWeapons.LR: Target anywhere on the map to cause the weapons of all of your human soldiers and ships to burst into flame, increasing their attack for a short period of time.

WalkingWoods.name: WalkingWoods
WalkingWoods.NAME: Walking Woods
WalkingWoods.LR: Target near a forest to animate the trees to attack nearby enemies. The animated trees are strong against buildings and decent against units.

Tempest.name: Tempest
Tempest.NAME: Tempest
Tempest.LR: Target a location to unleash a vicious hailstorm, damaging enemies and heavily slowing their attacks and movement.

Ragnarok.name: Ragnarok
Ragnarok.NAME: Ragnarok
Ragnarok.LR: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all of your Gatherers and Dwarves into mighty Heroes of Ragnarok.

Fimbulwinter.name: Fimbulwinter
Fimbulwinter.NAME: Fimbulwinter
Fimbulwinter.LR: Target anywhere on the map to summon packs of ferocious wolves to attack enemy Town Centers.

Nidhogg.name: Nidhogg
Nidhogg.NAME: Nidhogg
Nidhogg.LR: Select a location to summon the mighty Norse dragon from his delve beneath the earth.

Inferno.name: Inferno
Inferno.NAME: Inferno
Inferno.LR: Target a fiery path of destruction. The great wolf Fenrir will emerge and charge, engulfing enemies in flames before erupting into an apocalyptic inferno of flame and ruin.

TitanGate.name: TitanGate
TitanGate.NAME: Titan Gate
TitanGate.LR: Target a location to place a Titan Gate. Once your Villagers finish clearing the debris, a Titan will emerge.

Goatunheim.name: Goatunheim
Goatunheim.NAME: Goatunheim
Goatunheim.LR: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all units into tasty Goats. BAAAAAAH!
